prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, new_screen] Pet personality selection screen: Adds a new personality trait selector screen before picking a pet companion.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "new_personality", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "sign_in", "home_intro"], "new_personality": {"headline": "Choose your pet's personality", "body": "Select traits like playful, calm, or curious to shape how your pet behaves on desktop.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "text": "Playful, Calm, Energetic, Cozy", "style": "rounded", "action": "choose"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Continue to Adoption", "style": "emphasis", "action": "next"}]}}
1: [finish, redesign] Mascot welcome party home intro redesign: Redesigns the home intro screen with animated mascot elements demonstrating live desktop pet movement.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Your pet is officially live on your desktop!", "body": "Watch your pet walk around your screen and learn how to interact right away.", "replace": {"home_welcome": [{"role": "home_welcome", "type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:pet_welcome_mascot", "style": "playful"}, {"role": "home_welcome", "type": "animation", "asset": "asset:desktop_walk_anim", "style": "large"}]}}}
2: [choose_path, new_flow] Interactive pet preference story flow: Rebuilds the intro story screen into an interactive decision flow comparing quick adoption vs custom generation.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "carousel", "headline": "Welcome to Desktop Pets", "body": "Select how you would like to meet your new digital companion today.", "replace": {"intro_story": [{"role": "intro_story", "type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Preset companions vs custom AI creation", "style": "playful"}]}}}
3: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign in step before photo upload: Reorders sign-in to take place immediately after picking a friend and before custom photo upload.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "sign_in", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [sign_in, hint] Existing account sync hint on sign in: Displays an explicit hint confirming that signing in restores existing pets associated with the user account.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in connects your existing desktop pets and adoption history safely to this device."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop background rendering progress indicator: Displays detailed progress stages and estimated completion time during the waiting step.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Preparing your desktop pet canvas", "body": "Setting up sprite animations and desktop window controls..."}}
6: [choose_path, copy] Instant activation promise path copy: Updates choose_path headline and hints to explicitly state estimated time commitments for each path.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Choose your onboarding speed", "hint": "Quick pick adoption takes under 1 minute. Custom pet creation takes under 3 minutes."}}
7: [adoption, layout] Full bleed visual layout for photo upload: Changes the photo upload screen layout to full bleed with simplified drag-and-drop instructions.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "full_bleed", "headline": "Upload your pet photo", "body": "Drag and drop any clear front-facing image of your pet to generate your animated companion."}}
8: [finish, incentive] Desktop shortcut interaction guide badge: Adds a desktop shortcut interaction tip badge explaining mouse controls on the home intro screen.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Tip: Right-click your pet on desktop anytime to access controls or hide it.", "style": "highlight"}]}}
9: [home, notification] Desktop system tray readiness notification toggle: Adds a desktop notification button on the waiting screen to alert users when rendering finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "button", "label": "Notify me when pet is ready", "style": "plain", "action": "next"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Valid addition of a new onboarding screen without removing required steps or violating rules.
Redesigning the home intro screen is allowed inside onboarding.
The story screen loses its required job of introducing the pet by turning into a path choice flow.
Reordering sign-in within onboarding is explicitly permitted and keeps all required steps.
Adding an account sync hint on the sign-in screen is permitted.
Updating waiting screen progress info and timing is explicitly permitted and preserves the screen's job.
Copy change describes time estimates for both paths without introducing false urgency or pricing.
Full bleed layout redesign preserves the job of uploading pet photos.
Adding an interaction tip badge to the home intro is allowed within onboarding.
Adding readiness notification options on the waiting screen is explicitly allowed.
